This 2019 Toyota Camry LE delivers reliable performance and practical comfort for your daily drives and beyond.

- 2.5L I4 DOHC 16V engine with 8-speed automatic transmission
- Apple CarPlay compatibility
- Entune 3.0 Audio Plus with App Suite
- Power driver seat with lumbar support capability
- Rear backup camera for safe reversing
- Automatic headlights with delay-off feature
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- Dual front and side impact airbags plus knee and overhead airbags
- Remote keyless entry
- Power windows, mirrors, and steering wheel controls
- Split-folding rear seat for flexible cargo space
- 17-inch alloy wheels
- Steering wheel-mounted audio controls

The Camry LE combines everyday practicality with thoughtful design. Finished in black, this sedan presents a clean, professional appearance. The adaptive lighting system, including fully automatic headlights and delay-off functionality, enhances both safety and convenience during low-light conditions. Inside, the front bucket seats provide comfortable seating for regular commutes, while the split-folding rear seat expands your options for passengers or cargo.

Your fuel efficiency matters, and this Camry delivers with an EPA rating of 28 city and 39 highway miles per gallon. The responsive 2.5L four-cylinder engine paired with the smooth eight-speed automatic transmission provides dependable acceleration when you need it, while maintaining economy on longer stretches.

Safety is built into every aspect of this vehicle. The comprehensive airbag system, electronic stability control, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS work together to protect you and your passengers. The rear backup camera provides visibility when reversing, and the low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed about your vehicle's maintenance needs.

Technology keeps you connected and in control. Apple CarPlay integration lets you access your smartphone's essential functions safely, while the Entune 3.0 Audio system with AM/FM radio and app suite keeps you entertained. Steering wheel-mounted controls let you manage audio and speed settings without taking your hands off the wheel.

The Camry LE offers the kind of reliability and straightforward capability that makes it an excellent choice for drivers who value practicality and peace of mind. With well-maintained mechanicals, helpful technology features, and a roomy interior, this sedan is ready for whatever your week brings.

Safety and visibility are prioritized with automatic high-beam headlights, front fog lamps, and a rear window defroster. The backup camera helps navigate tight spaces with confidence, while electronic stability control and traction control work to keep the Equinox stable in various driving conditions. Four-wheel independent suspension contributes to a composed ride.

The LT trim balances premium features with practicality. An 8-way power driver seat allows personalized comfort adjustment, the leather-wrapped steering wheel adds refinement, and the universal home remote lets you manage your garage without additional remotes. Premium cloth seating, front and rear reading lights, and a trip computer round out the thoughtful cabin design.

This white Equinox LT presents a well-maintained option with strong equipment and genuine utility. Whether commuting to work, managing weekend errands, or enjoying weekend getaways, this crossover delivers dependable performance and practical comfort. We invite you to see this vehicle in person and confirm it meets your driving needs.

Meet the 2023 Nissan Kicks SR, a practical and efficient vehicle built for everyday driving. This red compact crossover combines smart design with proven reliability, offering you a dependable choice for navigating city streets and highways alike.

- 6-speaker audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- Blind Spot Warning for enhanced awareness

- Automatic temperature control and rear window defroster

- 17-inch alloy wheels

- Heated power door mirrors with turn signal indicators

- Front and rear disc brakes with electronic stability control
- Split folding rear seat for flexible cargo space

The Kicks delivers an impressive balance of economy and practicality. Rated at 31 city and 36 highway mpg, this front-wheel drive crossover helps keep fuel costs manageable while the CVT transmission provides smooth, responsive acceleration when you need it. The 1.6L four-cylinder engine provides adequate power for daily commutes and weekend trips without compromise.

Convenient touches include a tilting and telescoping steering wheel, a trip computer to track your efficiency, and intuitive controls positioned within easy reach. Climate control keeps the cabin at your preferred temperature, while the rear window defroster ensures clear visibility in all conditions.

Safety is engineered throughout this vehicle. Electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist work together to maintain control in challenging conditions. The backup camera and rear parking sensors provide visual confirmation when reversing, and blind spot monitoring adds an extra layer of awareness. Multiple airbags, including side curtain protection, are positioned strategically to help protect occupants.

Driver-focused features enhance convenience and safety. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your hands on the road while managing entertainment. Auto high-beam headlights adjust automatically to oncoming traffic, reducing driver fatigue on evening drives. The exterior parking camera provides a clear view behind you, making parking and maneuvering easier in tight spaces.

With 50,641 miles on the odometer, this Kicks represents excellent value for someone seeking a well-maintained, capable compact crossover. The carpeted floor mats and cargo mat protect the interior, while four-piece splash guards help shield the body from road debris. This is a vehicle ready to serve you reliably for years to come.

The power-fold heated side mirrors and remote start system are especially useful in colder climates, while the Sony In-Dash 6-Disc CD Player and steering wheel-mounted audio controls cater to tech-savvy drivers. Additional features like front fog lights and an auto-dimming rearview mirror complete a package focused on daily convenience and all-conditions versatility.

Against rivals like the Chevrolet Silverado 1500 and Ram 1500, the F-150 FX4 asserts its value by offering many premium features as standard equipment while others make buyers pay more or require higher trims. The FX4's unique blend of off-road capability, advanced safety systems, and upscale interior touches secures its place as a high-value, proven option in the used truck market. This 2016 Audi A3 2.0T Premium quattro in Black represents a refined choice for drivers seeking European engineering with practical everyday performance.

- Heated front seats
- Navigation system
- Audi Advanced Key with keyless start and entry
- Xenon Plus high intensity discharge headlights
- Power moonroof
- 18-inch 10-spoke Audi Sport wheels
- Leather seating surfaces
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C
- SiriusXM AM/FM radio with CD player
- Exterior parking camera
- Audi Concert sound system with 10 speakers
- Rain-sensing wipers
- Power driver seat
- Remote keyless entry
- Steering wheel-mounted audio controls

The 2.0L 4-cylinder TFSI engine paired with the 6-speed S tronic automatic transmission delivers responsive performance while maintaining reasonable fuel economy at 24 city and 33 highway miles per gallon. The quattro all-wheel-drive system provides confident traction in varied driving conditions, contributing to this vehicles well-balanced driving experience on both city streets and highway routes.

Premium appointments throughout the cabin establish an upscale environment. Leather steering wheel and shift knob add tactile refinement, while the power moonroof creates an open-air feeling. The navigation system integrates seamlessly with the Audi Concert audio setup, keeping you connected and informed during your travels. Heated front seats provide comfort during colder months, and the dual-zone automatic temperature control ensures both driver and passenger satisfaction.

Safety and convenience features reflect Audis attention to driver needs. The Audi Advanced Key system allows keyless operation, eliminating the need to retrieve a traditional key. Eight airbags, electronic stability control, ABS brakes, and traction control work together to help protect occupants. The rear parking camera assists with reversing maneuvers, while rain-sensing wipers automatically adjust to weather conditions.

Practical details enhance daily usability. Split-folding rear seats accommodate larger cargo when needed, while Audi Guard all-weather floor mats protect the interior. The rear window defroster clears visibility quickly, and delay-off headlights provide safety when exiting the vehicle at night. This A3 combines European sophistication with the everyday practicality buyers value.

We welcome the opportunity to have you experience this vehicle in person. Our team is ready to discuss financing options, answer any questions, and help you understand why this A3 represents solid value in the premium compact sedan segment.

This 2012 Cadillac SRX Luxury delivers refined capability with a spacious crossover design finished in Platinum Ice Tricoat White, offering the presence and versatility today's drivers expect.

- Power UltraView double-sized sunroof

The 3.6L V6 SIDI engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission provides balanced performance, delivering an estimated 17 mpg in the city and 24 mpg on the highway. The front-wheel-drive layout contributes to confident handling and responsive steering, making this crossover suitable for both daily commuting and longer trips.

The SRX Luxury prioritizes driver comfort and control. The memory package ensures your preferred seat, mirror, and pedal positions are restored automatically each time you enter the vehicle. Heated leather seating surfaces keep occupants comfortable during cold weather, while dual-zone climate control allows both driver and passenger to maintain individual temperature preferences.

Technology features integrate seamlessly into your drive. The integrated navigation system works in concert with voice recognition and iPod support, keeping your attention on the road. Bluetooth connectivity handles phone calls safely, and the SiriusXM satellite radio brings expanded entertainment options wherever you travel.

Practical storage and visibility features enhance daily usability. The power liftgate opens and closes at a preset height you control through memory, and the retractable cargo shade keeps belongings out of sight. Multiple cameras and park assist sensors provide confidence during parking maneuvers, while front and rear reading lights and illuminated entry points add convenience during evening hours.

This 2012 Cadillac SRX Luxury offers the combination of technology, comfort, and capable performance that makes owning a refined crossover a practical choice for discerning drivers. We invite you to schedule a viewing and discover how well this vehicle suits your lifestyle.

This 2019 Jeep Cherokee Latitude Plus offers the versatility and capability you need for both daily commutes and weekend adventures, backed by a proven 3.2L V6 engine paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission and 4WD.

- Backup Camera
- Bluetooth
- Power Full Sunroof
- Cold Weather Group with Engine Block Heater, Remote Start System, and Heated Front Seats
- Comfort/Convenience Group with 115V Auxiliary Power Outlet and Power Liftgate
- Premium Alpine Speaker System
- Uconnect 4 with 7 Display
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio with Apple CarPlay/Android Auto Integration

- Power Multi-Function Fold Away Mirrors

The 3.2L V6 engine delivers solid performance with excellent V6 efficiency, returning up to 19 mpg in the city and 27 mpg on the highway. The 9-speed automatic transmission and 4WD system work together to provide confident handling across various road conditions, whether you're navigating city streets or exploring off-road trails. The auxiliary transmission oil cooler ensures reliable performance during demanding driving situations.

Inside, you'll find a comfortable and well-appointed cabin designed with your convenience in mind. The dual-zone automatic temperature control allows both driver and passenger to set preferred climate settings independently. Heated front seats and a heated steering wheel make cold mornings more comfortable, while the premium Alpine speaker system delivers quality audio throughout the cabin. The Uconnect 4 interface with its 7-inch touchscreen keeps you connected with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration, plus SiriusXM satellite radio access.

Safety and visibility are prioritized throughout this Cherokee. The blind spot and cross path detection system provides added awareness, while the rear park assist with stop capability makes backing into tight spaces easier. The ParkView rear back-up camera displays a clear view of obstacles behind you, and front fog lights enhance visibility in challenging weather conditions.

The Cold Weather Group and Comfort/Convenience Group packages reflect this Latitude Plus's comprehensive feature set. Power windows, locks, and steering combine with a power liftgate for easy cargo access. The power multi-function fold-away mirrors adapt to your driving needs, and the roof rack rails are ready for your gear. Remote keyless entry and a security alarm protect your investment.

With 89,388 miles, this Cherokee Latitude Plus remains a practical choice for buyers seeking a well-equipped SUV with proven durability. The combination of 4WD capability, family-friendly interior space, and modern convenience features makes this an attractive option for active lifestyles. Schedule your test drive today and experience how this Jeep can meet your transportation needs.

The reclining third-row seat adds flexibility for both passengers and cargo, while the split-folding rear seat allows you to configure the space based on your immediate needs. Front bucket seating provides comfort for daily commutes, and the power driver seat makes finding your ideal driving position effortless.

Under the hood, a V6 engine paired with Xtronic CVT delivers 20 city and 27 highway mpg, offering a balance of performance and fuel efficiency for highway trips and daily navigation. Front-wheel drive provides reliable traction in most driving conditions, while the four-wheel independent suspension absorbs road imperfections smoothly.

Safety features demonstrate Nissan's commitment to protecting occupants. Blind Spot Warning alerts you to vehicles in your peripheral vision, while rear parking sensors assist when backing up. Dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, and an overhead airbag provide comprehensive protection. Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control work together to maintain vehicle dynamics, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS give you confidence in stopping power.

Climate control adapts to passenger preferences with front dual-zone automatic temperature control and rear air conditioning, ensuring comfort throughout the cabin. The NissanConnect audio system with AM/FM/CD functionality syncs with Bluetooth for hands-free calling and audio streaming. SiriusXM satellite radio expands your entertainment options, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road.

This one-owner, non-smoking vehicle comes equipped with practical protective features including cross bars for roof organization, rear bumper protection, and splash guards. Fully automatic headlights and delay-off functionality enhance visibility and convenience, while the telescoping and tilt steering wheel accommodates drivers of various heights and preferences.

We invite you to visit our Nissan dealership in Manchester, Tennessee, to experience this Pathfinder firsthand and discuss how it fits your family's lifestyle and driving needs.

This 2004 Dodge Ram 2500 SLT stands ready to deliver the toughness and capability you need for serious work or towing demands.

- 4-Wheel Drive with 4-Speed Automatic Transmission
- Cummins 600 5.9L I6 DI 24V High-Output Turbodiesel Engine
- Trailer Tow Group with Class IV Hitch and 7-Pin Wiring Harness
- Heavy Duty Snow Plow Prep Group with 160-Amp Alternator

This truck features the legendary Cummins diesel engine paired with a 4-speed automatic transmission, a combination built to handle substantial loads with dependable performance. The 4-wheel drive system provides the traction and control needed for challenging terrain and weather conditions. Whether you're managing a job site, maintaining property, or hauling equipment, this Ram 2500 SLT delivers the capability required.

The anti-spin rear axle adds another layer of control when navigating difficult conditions or managing heavy loads.

Practical features round out the package. The sliding rear window allows convenient access to cargo, while the folding trailer tow mirrors collapse when not needed. Fog lamps improve visibility in adverse weather, and the heavy-duty snow plow prep group ensures the truck can handle demanding seasonal work. Chrome bumpers add durability and style to the exterior.

Inside, you'll find functional comfort with power windows, tilt steering wheel, speed control, and a cloth split-bench seat designed for work-truck practicality. The AM/FM CD player with changer control provides entertainment options during your drives, while air conditioning keeps you comfortable in warm weather. Remote keyless entry adds convenience to daily operation.

This 2024 Honda Ridgeline RTL in Gray delivers the capability and refinement you expect from a midsize truck designed for both work and everyday driving.

- 3.5L V6 SOHC i-VTEC engine with 9-speed automatic transmission and AWD
- 215-watt audio system with 7 speakers and SiriusXM satellite radio
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Wireless Android Auto integration
- Heated front bucket seats with leather trim and power adjustment
- Power moonroof for added comfort and open-air appeal

- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone and rear air conditioning

The Ridgeline RTL combines truck utility with premium comfort features that make every drive smoother. The responsive 3.5L V6 engine paired with the 9-speed automatic transmission provides the power you need without sacrificing efficiency.

Inside, you'll find a thoughtfully designed cabin that prioritizes your comfort and connectivity. Heated leather front seats keep you warm during cold mornings, while the power moonroof creates an open, airy atmosphere. The dual-zone automatic climate control ensures both driver and passenger stay comfortable, and heated mirrors and rear air conditioning extend that comfort throughout the vehicle.

Technology integration is seamless with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, allowing you to access your favorite apps and navigation systems without cables. The SiriusXM satellite radio keeps you entertained on longer drives, while Bluetooth hands-free connectivity keeps you connected safely to calls and music.

Safety is built into every aspect of the RTL. The Blind Spot Information system provides visual warnings when changing lanes, the rearview backup camera helps with parking and reversing, and the comprehensive airbag system includes dual front and side impact protection. Electronic stability control and four-wheel independent suspension work together to keep you confident in various driving situations.

This Ridgeline with 37,623 miles represents a truck ready to serve you reliably for years to come. The combination of proven Honda engineering, thoughtful features, and genuine capability makes this an excellent choice for buyers seeking a truck that handles both responsibilities and lifestyle demands. Visit our showroom to see this truck in person and take it for a test drive.

Navigation is built in, eliminating the need for external devices. The Bose audio system with SiriusXM 360L transforms your commute into an entertainment experience, whether you're listening to music, news, or talk radio.

The panoramic moonroof enhances the cabin's openness, while the touch-free power rear door with easy closer makes loading cargo effortless, especially when your hands are full.

The 3500 lbs tow prep package, which includes a heavy-duty radiator, engine cooler, and transmission cooler, readies the vehicle for light towing needs. The cold area package adds features like automatic headlamp leveling and windshield wiper deicer for winter driving confidence. With its comprehensive feature set and F SPORT enhancements, this vehicle offers both capability and style.

The integrated trailer brake controller handles braking coordination with confidence.

The Elevation trim strikes the right balance between value and useful features. Heavy-duty rear springs, increased rear axle weight rating, and a 220-amp alternator support demanding work. The locking differential provides traction when you need extra grip in challenging terrain. Remote keyless entry with push-button start and a universal home remote add convenience to daily routines.

This stunning 2025 Subaru Crosstrek Premium in Blue combines practicality with refined comfort, offering a vehicle you can confidently drive every day. With just 7,069 miles, this one-owner vehicle carries a clean AutoCheck history and represents an excellent opportunity to own a nearly new crossover without compromise.

- Blind Spot Detection (BSD) with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert (RCTA)
- Power Moonroof with tilt-up, auto-open/close, and UV-tinted glass
- 10-Way Power Driver's Seat with lumbar support
- Dual-Mode Heated Front Seats for comfort in cold weather
- Auto-Dimming Mirror with Compass and HomeLink integration
- Auto-Dimming Exterior Mirror with Approach Light
- All-Weather Package including heated power mirrors and de-icer wipers
- Subaru 11.6 Multimedia Plus System with SiriusXM
- LED Upgrade headlights for improved visibility
- Backup Camera for enhanced parking convenience
- Front fog lights and fully automatic headlights

The 2.5L 4-cylinder engine paired with the Lineartronic CVT delivers efficient performance, achieving 27 city MPG and 33 highway MPG for a balanced driving experience. All-wheel drive ensures confident handling across various road conditions, while the independent four-wheel suspension provides a smooth, composed ride whether navigating city streets or highway expanses.

Inside, the Premium trim prioritizes your comfort and convenience. The cloth upholstery maintains a fresh appearance, while dual-zone automatic temperature control allows both driver and passenger to set preferred settings independently. The front bucket seats with center armrest provide comfortable support for daily commutes or longer journeys, and the split-folding rear seat adapts to your cargo needs.

Safety features throughout this Crosstrek reflect Subaru's commitment to protection. The comprehensive airbag system includes dual front impact, dual front side impact, knee, and overhead airbags. Anti-whiplash front head restraints, electronic stability control, traction control, and ABS brakes work together to help keep you secure. The blind spot detection system actively monitors your blind spots while the rear cross-traffic alert assists during reversing situations.

Entertainment and connectivity are handled by the 11.6-inch multimedia system, which integrates SiriusXM satellite radio and steering wheel-mounted audio controls. Remote keyless entry, illuminated entry, and the overhead console with trip computer ensure convenient daily operation. The power steering, telescoping and tilt steering wheel, and easy-to-read tachometer and gauges create an intuitive driving environment.

With minimal mileage and one owner, this 2025 Subaru Crosstrek Premium represents an excellent choice for buyers seeking a reliable, well-equipped compact crossover. We invite you to schedule a visit to see this vehicle in person and experience the quality craftsmanship Subaru delivers.

- HEMI 5.7L V8 Multi Displacement VVT engine with 8-speed automatic transmission
- All-wheel drive for confident handling in varying conditions
- Quick Order Package 22T R/T Plus with premium appointments
- Power 8-way driver and passenger memory seats with ventilation and heating

Inside, the cabin combines practical functionality with genuine comfort through leather-trimmed bucket seats, a leather-wrapped sport steering wheel, and a leather-wrapped floor console with armrest. The power sunroof bathes the interior in natural light, while ambient lighting creates an inviting atmosphere during evening drives.

This three-row SUV prioritizes passenger comfort and versatility. Heated and ventilated front seats keep occupants at ideal temperatures, while the split-folding rear seats adapt to your cargo needs. The second row benefits from its own heating system, ensuring everyone travels in comfort. Climate control manages temperature independently for driver and front passenger, with dedicated rear air conditioning maintaining comfort for all passengers.

Safety is woven throughout the Durango's design with a comprehensive airbag system, electronic stability control, traction control, and speed-sensing steering that adapts to your driving. The ParkView rear backup camera, rain-sensing wipers, and auto high-beam headlights with delay-off functionality reduce driver workload and enhance awareness. Low tire pressure warning and an emergency communication system through SiriusXM Guardian provide additional peace of mind during travels.

The HEMI engine delivers authority on the road, achieving 14 city and 22 highway MPG with eight-speed automatic transmission management. Adaptive cruise control with stop functionality can handle highway cruising or start-and-stop traffic, while the auto-leveling suspension maintains composure regardless of loading conditions. The four-wheel independent suspension with rear load leveling ensures stable handling whether fully loaded or lightly provisioned.

We invite you to visit our showroom and experience the 2023 Dodge Durango R/T Plus firsthand, where you can sit in those supportive seats, explore the intuitive technology interface, and begin envisioning how this three-row SUV fits into your lifestyle and adventures ahead.

description:
This 2024 Mazda CX-30 2.5 S in Blue delivers practical performance and thoughtful design for drivers who value quality and reliability in their compact crossover.

- SKYACTIV®-G 2.5L 4-Cylinder Engine with 6-Speed Automatic and AWD
- MAZDA CONNECT Infotainment System with AppLink/Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- 4-Wheel Disc Brakes with ABS
- Dual front impact airbags, side impact airbags, and knee airbag
- Electronic Stability Control with Traction Control
- Auto High-beam Headlights with Delay-off Feature
- Remote Keyless Entry with Panic Alarm
- Steering Wheel Mounted Audio Controls
- Power door mirrors and power windows
- Air Conditioning with Rear Window Defroster
- Front Bucket Seats with Split Folding Rear Seat
- 16 Aluminum Alloy Wheels with Wheel Locks
- Speed-Sensing Power Steering
- Mazda Connected Services with 3-Year Complimentary Trial

With just 9,705 miles on the odometer, this CX-30 remains virtually new and ready to serve your transportation needs with confidence. The efficient SKYACTIV®-G engine delivers 26 city and 33 highway mpg, balancing everyday driving efficiency with the capability of all-wheel drive when conditions demand it.

The interior accommodates passengers comfortably with front bucket seating and a split folding rear seat that adapts to your cargo needs. Climate control and convenient power windows and mirrors contribute to a refined driving experience. The MAZDA CONNECT system integrates with your smartphone through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected while remaining focused on the road.

Safety is engineered throughout this vehicle with a comprehensive airbag system, electronic stability control, traction control, and 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS. The rear parking camera provides visual guidance when maneuvering in tight spaces, while the low tire pressure warning system helps maintain optimal vehicle performance. Mazda Connected Services offers emergency communication capabilities with three years complimentary.

The exterior parking camera rear adds practical visibility for backing up safely, while automatic headlights and rear window wiper enhance convenience in varying weather conditions. The body-color bumpers and spoiler contribute to a cohesive, polished appearance that maintains its appeal.

With minimal mileage and comprehensive technology features, this CX-30 2.5 S represents a genuine opportunity to own a well-equipped crossover that will serve your daily driving with reliability and comfort.

You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. description:
Discover the versatility and capability of this 2021 Ford Bronco Sport Big Bend, a dependable compact SUV engineered for drivers who demand both style and substance on any road.

This Bronco Sport Big Bend comes equipped with a comprehensive array of features designed for comfort and convenience:

- 1.5L EcoBoost engine with 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability
- SYNC 3 Communications & Entertainment System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- SiriusXM satellite radio with AM/FM stereo and six speakers
- Automatic temperature control with air conditioning and rear window defroster
- Unique cloth front bucket seats with front center armrest and split-folding rear seat
- Exterior parking camera for confident reverse navigation
- Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and brake assist for enhanced safety
- Auto high-beam headlights, front fog lights, and fully automatic headlight operation
- 17-inch carbonized gray-painted aluminum alloy wheels
- Speed-sensing steering and four-wheel independent suspension
- Remote keyless entry with illuminated entry system
- Heated power door mirrors with power windows
- Roof rack with rails for additional cargo capacity
- Steering wheel-mounted audio controls and cruise control

The gray exterior pairs with a modern cabin that prioritizes your driving experience. Inside, you'll find thoughtful touches like the trip computer, compass, and overhead console that keep important information at your fingertips. The tilt and telescoping steering wheel adjusts to your preferred driving position, while the climate control system maintains your ideal cabin temperature throughout the year.

Safety features are integrated throughout the design. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags provide comprehensive protection. The vehicle includes four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction control to help you maintain confidence in various driving conditions. The low tire pressure warning system and occupant sensing airbag technology add additional layers of protection for you and your passengers.

The SYNC 3 system connects your smartphone seamlessly through Apple CarPlay or Android Auto, allowing you to access navigation, messaging, and your favorite music without taking your hands off the wheel. Steering wheel controls let you manage audio and communication features intuitively while driving.

With city fuel economy of 25 MPG and highway fuel economy of 28 MPG, this Bronco Sport Big Bend balances capability with efficiency. The 4WD system and independent suspension work together to handle various terrains while maintaining a comfortable ride during everyday driving.

Bring this 2021 Ford Bronco Sport Big Bend in for a test drive today and experience the balance of capability, comfort, and modern features that make this SUV an excellent choice for your next vehicle.

Inside, the cloth front bucket seats with center armrest provide comfortable seating, while the split folding rear seat expands cargo versatility. A 4.2" color display provides trip information and vehicle diagnostics at a glance.

Technology features make every drive more connected and secure. The Chevrolet MyLink system integrates your smartphone through Bluetooth, while SiriusXM satellite radio expands your entertainment options. OnStar provides emergency assistance, roadside support, and navigation tools when you need them.

The truck's exterior combines function with purposeful styling. The Z71 appearance package delivers aggressive design cues, while the front and rear body-color bumpers, polished-aluminum wheels, and LED fog lamps create a modern look. Chrome accents on the front bumper and rear step add polish, and the remote locking tailgate with integrated cargo lighting enhances practicality.

This 2018 Ford Escape Titanium delivers a capable and refined driving experience backed by thoughtful engineering and modern convenience features.

- 2.0L EcoBoost turbocharged engine with 6-speed automatic transmission and 4WD
- Ford Safe & Smart Package with adaptive cruise control and forward collision warning
- Blind Spot Information System with cross-traffic alert
- Lane-Keeping System with lane-keeping alert and driver alert system

Climate control is managed through automatic temperature settings with front dual-zone capability, while rear window defrosting clears visibility in adverse conditions. The power driver seat with memory settings allows you to find your ideal driving position with ease.

The Ford Safe & Smart Package enhances your confidence on the road with multiple layers of driver assistance. Adaptive cruise control maintains your set speed while the forward collision warning system alerts you to potential hazards. The blind spot information system eliminates hidden areas, and the lane-keeping system provides alerts and corrective aid to keep you centered in your lane.

Technology integration centers on SYNC 3, which brings seamless smartphone connectivity through AppLink, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto. Voice-activated navigation and SiriusXM satellite radio are available to keep you informed and entertained. A 10-speaker audio system ensures quality sound throughout the cabin.

Safety is prioritized with a comprehensive airbag system, electronic stability control, four-wheel independent suspension, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS. The emergency communication system through SYNC 3 911 Assist provides added peace of mind during unexpected situations.

This Escape Titanium represents a well-equipped crossover ready to handle your daily responsibilities while keeping you connected and protected on every drive.

description:
This 2017 Jeep Compass Latitude delivers the capability and comfort you expect from a trusted SUV, with refined styling and thoughtful engineering that makes every drive more enjoyable.

- ParkSense Rear Park Assist System
- Blind Spot & Cross Path Detection
- 8.4 Uconnect 4C Navigation Touchscreen Display
- Apple CarPlay and Google Android Auto
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio with 1-Year Service included
- Dual Zone Automatic Temperature Control
- Power 8-Way Driver Seat with 4-Way Lumbar Adjustment
- Remote Start System
- 18 Polished/Black Aluminum Wheels
- Auto-Dimming Rear-View Mirror
- ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera
- Seven airbags for enhanced safety
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Four Wheel Independent Suspension
- 7.0 Color Driver Information Display

The Compass is powered by a 2.4L I4 MultiAir engine paired with a 6-speed Aisin automatic transmission, delivering a balanced blend of capability and efficiency. This front-wheel-drive configuration achieves 22 city and 31 highway MPG, making it practical for both daily commutes and weekend adventures. With under 38,000 miles, this vehicle has been well-maintained and is ready for thousands more miles of reliable service.

The Latitude trim includes the Safe & Security Group, which adds valuable peace of mind with its rear park assist, security alarm, blind spot detection, and cross path detection. You'll also appreciate the Navigation Group featuring the Uconnect 4C system with its 8.4-inch touchscreen, integrated GPS, and smartphone compatibility through Apple CarPlay and Google Android Auto. This combination keeps you connected and informed throughout your journey.

The interior provides genuine comfort with premium cloth and vinyl bucket seats, power adjustment on the driver's side, and dual zone climate control to keep all occupants satisfied. The remote start system adds convenience during cold mornings or hot afternoons, while the heated door mirrors assist in challenging weather conditions. Storage is thoughtfully integrated with a front center armrest box and multiple door bins for organizing your essentials.

Safety is built into every aspect of this Compass. The vehicle is equipped with seven strategically placed airbags, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction control working together to help protect occupants. The 115V auxiliary power outlet provides charging capacity for devices and accessories, adding practical versatility.

description:
This 2015 Chevrolet Equinox LTZ combines capability with refined comfort, offering a well-equipped mid-size SUV that stands ready for both daily commutes and weekend adventures.

- Power tilt-sliding sunroof with express-open and wind deflector
- 3.6L V6 SIDI engine with variable valve timing (301 hp, 272 lb-ft torque)
- All-wheel drive with 6-speed automatic transmission
- Chevrolet MyLink audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio and 8 speakers
- Heated leather-appointed front seats with 8-way power adjustment
- Bluetooth connectivity for phone integration
- Rear parking camera with park assist and parking sensors
- Forward collision alert and lane departure warning
- Class II trailering equipment package with receiver hitch
- All-weather floor mats and protection package
- Automatic temperature control with rear window defroster
- 18-inch chrome-clad aluminum wheels
- Power liftgate and cargo area close-out panel
- Dual exhaust with premium tips
- OnStar Directions & Connections emergency communication system

The Equinox's 3.6L V6 engine delivers power when you need it, while the AWD system provides confident traction in varying conditions. The six-speed automatic transmission shifts smoothly through city driving and highway cruising, achieving 16 city and 23 highway MPG.

Inside, the LTZ trim elevates the experience with perforated leather-appointed seat trim and heated front seats essential features for those who spend considerable time behind the wheel. The 8-way power driver and passenger seats allow you to find your ideal position, while memory seat functionality ensures your preferences are restored each time you climb in. Automatic climate control maintains your desired cabin temperature without constant adjustment.

Technology integration keeps you connected through Chevrolet MyLink, offering seamless smartphone compatibility and SiriusXM satellite radio through eight speakers for quality audio. Steering wheel-mounted controls let you adjust settings without taking your hands from the wheel, and Bluetooth connectivity ensures your phone stays linked throughout your drive.

Safety receives careful attention with forward collision alert, lane departure warning, dual front and side impact airbags, and electronic stability control working together to protect your occupants. The rear parking camera and park assist sensors eliminate guesswork when maneuvering in tight spaces, while 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide reliable stopping power.

For those who tow, the Class II trailering equipment package with receiver hitch makes hitching straightforward. The LPO protection package adds all-weather floor mats and molded splash guards, safeguarding your interior from the elements.

This Equinox LTZ stands as a versatile SUV ready to meet your daily demands while providing the comfort and features you value. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience it firsthand.

The Prius IV delivers impressive fuel efficiency with 51 city MPG and 48 highway MPG, powered by a 1.8L 4-cylinder engine with VVT-i technology paired with a CVT transmission. This combination provides smooth, responsive performance while maximizing every gallon of fuel, making it an economical daily driver for commuters and highway travelers alike.

Inside the cabin, you'll find comfort-focused features that enhance every journey. Heated front bucket seats with natural leather trim provide warmth and support during cooler months. Steering wheel-mounted controls for both audio and climate management keep essential functions at your fingertips. The automatic temperature control maintains your preferred cabin environment effortlessly, while the rear window defroster ensures clear visibility in winter conditions.

Entertainment and connectivity are handled through the JBL audio system featuring an AM/FM receiver and 6-disc CD changer with eight speakers. The HomeLink garage door transmitter adds convenience for your daily routine. Digital amenities include an outside temperature display, trip computer, and illuminated entry, all contributing to an intuitive driving experience.

Safety has been engineered into every aspect of this vehicle. Multiple airbag systems including dual front impact, dual front side, and overhead airbags work with anti-whiplash front head restraints to protect occupants. Electronic Stability Control and traction control enhance handling in challenging conditions, while 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confident stopping power. The low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed about your tires' condition.

Power features and convenience elements make daily operation effortless. Power steering, windows, and door mirrors respond to your commands. Delay-off headlights extend illumination when you exit the vehicle, and the telescoping tilt steering wheel adjusts to your preferred driving position. Split folding rear seats expand cargo flexibility when needed.

This Prius IV represents the practical intersection of environmental consciousness and automotive responsibility. With proven Toyota reliability and comprehensive standard safety features, this vehicle is ready to serve as a dependable transportation solution for years to come. We invite you to experience the efficiency and capability of this well-equipped model firsthand.
